machine: Apple M5 laptop, Chrome, Balanced preset (60 FPS cap, render scale 1.25 = 1820x1186), on mains power

sightlines.method: __dev.sightlines(): eye-height lines (nav node + 0.65 m) between walkable nodes; spawn side = nodes beyond |z| 36; long = random pairs 40 m+ apart

18.0.worst: the centre exit to the far centre exit through the train (cab doors, aisle and gangways in line)

20.0_first_pass.note: the lines left ran along the track beds under the gantry's crossbeam

camouflage.method: __dev.camo(): an OMEGA operator posed facing the camera at 12/20/30 m, rendered with and without it in the same task; brightness contrast |L_bot - L_bg| / L_bg over its pixels; colour difference = mean per-channel difference (0-255)
camouflage.note: trackBed at 20 and 30 m: hidden by the gantries (0 pixels)

sniperDrill.method: __dev.sniperDrill(): a live 7v7 match, 999 tickets, the player in god mode a perfect marksman at a vantage, firing at the nearest OMEGA bot it sees 20-70 m away; per bot hit: died, or got out of sight alive
sniperDrill.columns: botsHit, kills, escaped, killsPerMin, escapedPct, exposedMedianS, timeToKillMedianS
sniperDrill.v1: underFire range 22, window 0.6, the 4 s break cooldown, slide 0.7 x persona
sniperDrill.shipped: underFire range 16, window 1.0, its own 1.5 s cooldown, always slides out when there is no cover spot

selfPlay.method: tdmSim: bot vs bot NvN, tickets 5 a player unless noted, 3 matches a cell
selfPlay.columns: minutes, killsPerMin, firstEngagementMedianS, quietPct, longHitEscapedPct, ttkFromFirstHitMedianS, killsOver25mPct, evades, evadeSlides, killRangeMedianM, laneTime_west/train/east

bench3_7v7_balanced_throughMenu.note: the billboards' screens are emissive maps (no light, no shadow pass: the sun's map is static); the cover is merged static geometry (one draw call per material)

stairGaps.before: 24 drops: the first west-hall billboard flush against the escalator

levelAI.before: 26 nodes unreachable: the same billboard walled the west hall off; a node column at x -27.2 added
